actions.Prepare: One explicit input-only action creates ten runtime XML/byte-exact BI4 copies and logs/upl_gpu_public_r1.inputs.json. Requires current public Debug/Release builds and owned default CPU Debug. No GenCase, solver, helper or physical-field reset.
actions.RunJob: One selected isolated canonical GPU main, NOT a private helper solver. Ordinary -gpu:0 -stable, plus -mdbc_freeslip only for walls. The two Debug smokes each use actual memcheck0errors/0leaks. No automatic next job or old-control execution.
actions.ReviewJob: One selected fresh offline reader comparison after a sealed owned solve. Explicit -ReaderBuildReceipt must identify the root-reviewed, same-configuration current110objects+one-reader closure. Reader protocol --compare Periodic|Wall constant|smooth Smoke|Full PRIVATE_DATA PUBLIC_DATA RUNTIME_XML DT NEWREVIEWDIR. No program or solver rerun for postprocessing failure.

authorization: Each action requires -ExecutionAuthorized after root full review. Authoring does not grant execution permission.
geometry_and_clock: Periodic512 soil/0fixed, wall1024soil/256fixed. Every full end2^-15s and cadence2^-23s. Smokes preserve their OWN sealed two-step dt/end/cadence. No new clock edits: the old selected runtime already has each declared clock. BI4 SHA364c4421...cd5a8fa periodic and76ead355...77a932f wall are copied exactly; original velocities/stresses/pressure/position/J initialization are not rewritten.
XML_diff: Only the three already implemented public key names HydroMechDynamicSeepage, HydroMechConductivityModel, HydroMechConductivityCk may change. Periodic old runtimes omit all three: insert them with preserved child/closing whitespace. Wall runtimes already contain them: alter values only. Set master1/model0/Ck0 for constant and master1/model1/Ck2^-13 for smooth. Reverse every insertion/value change on a fresh parsed saved document and require original OuterXml exactly; no other DOM, comments, numeric material or initialization may change.
control_adoption: Read sealed owned run/check/native completion and input receipts, verify all original raw PART bindings and their actual argv/program/exit. Old source/build/helper receipts are immutable identities, not permission to revalidate their historical mutable target source paths as current. Periodic full controls additionally bind current-wall no-wall exact33/history/ID bridge checks. Both private wall k0 short controls/admission are prerequisites only; this runner adds no public k0 trajectory.
current_build_closure: New upl_gpu_public_{Debug|Release}_r1.build.json:265current source/4allowedtargets/261unchanged,110objects excludingmain, raw baseline target copies, canonicalGPU6 and retained wall controls/runtime. Validate all current source/program/tool/runtime inputs before/after each actual invocation. Default CPU Debug is a separate owned exit0 receipt; no new CPU solve or timing benchmark.

phase_admissions.logs/upl_gpu_public_smoke_r1.admission.c: kind=smoke; root binds exactly both Debug check receipts before any Release solve.
phase_admissions.logs/upl_gpu_public_periodic_constant_r1: kind=periodic_constant; exact constant c/h, inherited_private_scientific_gates_passed=true before periodic smooth. Does NOT imply a new1percent continuum/reference/physical-wall endpoint gate.
phase_admissions.logs/upl_gpu_public_wall_constant_r1.adm: kind=wall_constant; exact constant c/h, inherited_private_scientific_gates_passed=true and inherited_wall_constant_one_percent_and_endpoint_budgets_passed=true before wall smooth.
phase_admissions.common: passed/all_original_gates_preserved true; job_checks exactly the two corresponding E entries; public_GPU_dynamic_accepted/physical_acceptance false. Every half job additionally requires its own actual coarse review. No automatic root admission is created.

reader_contract: Actual original15 typed arrays and J/theta all saved native particles, soil n and actual time/Step/lockedDt/signeddterror must be EXACT, with no exceptions, interpolation or masks. New six double dynamic arrays, actual float PosDiv, typed model/schema metadata and fixed n/V/rho/k zero markers are audited separately, not used to hide a shared-field mismatch. This does not claim whole raw-private/public equality, a new GPU PosDiv comparison against absent old data or a proof of compaction from this weak trajectory.
unchanged_single_run_gates: ledger relative<=5e-13;energy<=1.1;0<max|J-1|<=1e-4;actual native PosDiv nonempty; saved coupledCFL/Ddt-h2<=.01;signed dterror<=1e-14; smooth Full kspan/k0>=.005. Reader checks actual geometry/material/XML/IDs/exclusions and types. These saved-point checks are not independent every-force-stage telemetry or sufficient stability.
scientific_inheritance: Bind passed original Darcy constantGPUhalf/cross c/h, periodic smoothGPUhalf/cross/effect c/h and private wall constant admission/stage figures plus endpoint/native audit receipts. Only complete c/h bit-exact shared trajectories with matching inputs and unchanged current kernel closure can inherit those original5Pa/.005mm,normalized1e-4,wall1percent/nearwall/endpoint/flux/reaction budgets; any bit difference holds admission, not a5Pa tolerance fallback. No new half/cross/theory/endpoint audit is claimed by this driver. Periodic32 continuum floor around-1.47percent is not relabelled1percent acceptance. Ck2^-13 remains manufactured, not calibrated soil data or an accuracy gain.
outputs: New outputs/upl_gpu_public_seed_r1; each job outputs/upl_gpu_public_JOB_r1 and _review; logs/upl_gpu_public_JOB_r1.call/run/check.json plus _review.call/log. Reader emits common.csv/public_extra.csv/native_ids.csv/fixed_ids.csv/history.csv/input_files.csv/completion.json; no physical.bin fabricated.
preservation: Fresh paths only; precreate native-call logs; native stderr uses explicit exit checking. Failed calls/runs/checks and partial raw outputs are sealed. A completed solve is never relaunched to repair analysis. No source/docs/old controls/worker changes, watchers, notifiers, canonical/server install or Git actions.
held: True mDBC default-OFF151 regression, negative public inputs and PART rejection remain later separate work. No public physical/general boundary/gravity/load/drainage/plasticity/full-cycle/restart or formal/server admission.
